questions.question: How does alcohol affect you?

questions.question: You are driving past parked cars. You notice a wheel of a bicycle sticking out in between them. What should you do ?
options: A) Accelerate past quickly and sound your horn.
B) Slow down and be prepared to stop for a cyclist.
C) Brake sharply only when you can see the cyclist.
questions.answer: B) Slow down and be prepared to stop for a cyclist.

questions.question: You need a longer distance to stop your motorcycle when riding
options: A) on a wet road
B) on a dry road
C) on hard ground
questions.answer: A) on a wet road

questions.question: You should adjust the mirrors of your motorcycle
options: A) while the motorcycle is on the main stand
B) whilst seated on the motorcycle
C) after moving off
questions.answer: B) whilst seated on the motorcycle

questions.question: You should adjust your _________so that all controls can be reached without having to stretch:
options: A) Seat belt
B) Eye-sight
C) Driver seat
questions.answer: C) Driver seat

questions.question: You should not declutch when
options: A) Slowing down
B) Going round a bend
C) Changing gears
questions.answer: B) Going round a bend

questions.question: You should not look down at the front wheel when riding because it can
options: A) make your steering lighter
B) upset your balance
C) improve your balance
questions.answer: B) upset your balance

questions.question: You should turn off the throttle briskly when
options: A) accelerating
B) changing gears
C) releasing clutch lever
questions.answer: B) changing gears

questions.question: Your brakes do not work properly after riding through deep water.  To dry them you should
options: A) ride slowly and brake lightly
B) ride quickly and braking harshly
C) stop and dry them with newspaper
questions.answer: A) ride slowly and brake lightly

questions.question: Your overall stopping distance will be longer when driving
options: A) In the rain.
B) At night.
C) In strong wind.
questions.answer: A) In the rain.

questions.question: Your vehicle has a puncture on the expressway.  What should you do ?
options: A) Drive slowly to the workshop.
B) Pull up on the road shoulder.
C) Stop in your lane and switch on the hazard lights.
questions.answer: B) Pull up on the road shoulder.

questions.question: Before reaching a junction, you should;
options: A) Form up into the correct lane which you intend to travel.
B)Sound your horn to caution other road users.
C) Speed up so as not to cause a traffic jam.
questions.answer: A) Form up into the correct lane which you intend to travel.

questions.question: On a two-way street with two lanes in each direction, you should keep to;
options: A) the left lane.
B)the outer lane.
C) either answers.
questions.answer: A) the left lane.

questions.question: On a two-lane carriageway, you should
options: A) keep to the left lane
B) keep to the outer lane
C)not overtake another vehicle
questions.answer: A) keep to the left lane

questions.question: Switching lanes suddenly or abruptly will
options: A) improve the flow of traffic on the road.
B) cause inconvenience and danger to other motorists.
C) cause wear and tear to the vehicle.
questions.answer: B) cause inconvenience and danger to other motorists.

questions.question: To maintain good lane discipline, you should
options: A) form up correctly into the intended lane before reaching the junction
B) drive between lanes so that you can switch lane easily
C) follow closely to the vehicle in front
questions.answer: A) form up correctly into the intended lane before reaching the junction

questions.question: Under what circumstances you may not follow the 'keep left rule' ?
options: A) When travelling at the maximum speed limit of the road.
B) When traffic is light.
C) When your path is obstructed.
questions.answer: C) When your path is obstructed.

questions.question: When driving along a two-way street, you should
options: A)always keep near the centre line of the road
B) not cross the centre line at bends
C) not overtake at all times
questions.answer: B) not cross the centre line at bends

questions.question: When turning right at a one-way street, you should position your vehicle
options: A) In the right hand lane.
B) Just left of the centre of the road.
C) In any lane depending on the traffic conditions.
questions.answer: A) In the right hand lane.

questions.question: You are driving on a three-lane carriageway at 80 km/h .There is no traffic ahead. Which lane should you use ?
options: A) Any lane.
B) Middle lane.
C) Left lane.
questions.answer: C) Left lane.

questions.question: You may overtake another vehicle on the left
options: A) If it is a heavy vehicle.
B) If the driver in front signals his intention to turn right.
C) If you are certain that the vehicle would not change direction.
questions.answer: B) If the driver in front signals his intention to turn right.

questions.question: When should you start to keep left after overtaking?
options: A) As soon as you are ahead of the overtaken vehicle.
B) When you can see the overtaken vehicle in your left wing mirror.
C) When you can see the overtaken vehicle in your rear view mirror inside the cabin.
questions.answer: C) When you can see the overtaken vehicle in your rear view mirror inside the cabin.

questions.question: Before overtaking another vehicle, you should signal for at least
options: A) Three  seconds
B) Five seconds
C) Seven seconds
questions.answer: A) Three  seconds

questions.question: If a motorcyclist is trying to overtake you, you should
options: A) Drive faster to prevent the rider from overtaking you
B) Slow down and assist the rider to overtaking safely
C) Signal the driver to overtake on the left
questions.answer: B) Slow down and assist the rider to overtaking safely

questions.question: If the car you are overtaking is drifting in its lane, you should
options: A) Use your horn to warn him
B) Signal him with your hand
C) Overtake it quickly
questions.answer: A) Use your horn to warn him

questions.question: To drive in a way where other drivers will not find it necessary to overtake you, you should
options: A) Drive on the extreme right lane all the time
B) Always drive at a speed that match the traffic flow
C)Drive at the maximun speed limit of the road all the time
questions.answer: B) Always drive at a speed that match the traffic flow

questions.question: When a motorcyclist tries to overtake you on the left, you should
options: A) Increase your speed to race the rider.
B) Reduce your speed and assist the rider to overtake safely.
C) Ignore the rider and continue driving at your normal speed.
questions.answer: B) Reduce your speed and assist the rider to overtake safely.

questions.question: When another vehicle is overtaking you, you should
options: A) not speed up but assist him to overtake
B)change lane and keep to the right
C) increase your speed gradually
questions.answer: A) not speed up but assist him to overtake

questions.question: When being overtaken, you should
options: A) speed up
B) maintain your speed
C) slow down
questions.answer: C) slow down

questions.question: When the motorcycle you are overtaking suddenly increases speed, you should
options: A) accelerate more to overtake it quickly
B) slow down and abort overtaking it
C) sound your horn to warn the driver
questions.answer: B) slow down and abort overtaking it.

questions.question: When you have moved to the right hand side of the road to overtake another vehicle, you should
options: A) Maintain your normal speed and overtake as usual
B) Accelerate and overtake as quickly as possible
C) Decelerate and change to a higher gear
questions.answer: B) Accelerate and overtake as quickly as possible

questions.question: While overtaking another vehicle, the vehicle suddenly goes faster, you should
options: A) accelerate hard to overtake quickly
B) slow down and move safely back to your lane
C) sound the horn continuously to warn the other driver
questions.answer: B) slow down and move safely back to your lane
